# Assets Guide

Complete reference for all assets in this repository.

---

## Directory Structure

```
ionity-assets/
├── images/          Logos, icons, social cards, author photos
├── css/             Global Ionity stylesheet
├── js/              JavaScript utilities
├── favicon/         Favicons (all platforms & sizes)
├── videos/          Brand intro and ecosystem videos
├── cookies/         Cookie consent HTML/JS
├── seo/             Schema.org JSON-LD structured data
├── Lisences,Policy,EULA/  Legal PDFs
└── assets/          Compressed bundles (.7z)
```

---

## Logos & Brand Images

All logo files are available in both **PNG** (raster) and **SVG** (vector) formats unless noted.

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `images/ionity-logo-edited.*` | Primary Ionity logo, transparent background |
| `images/ionity-today-logo-edited-*.png/.svg` | Ionity Today variant logo |
| `images/logo-dark-ionity-*.png/.svg` | Dark theme logo |
| `images/logo-white.*` | White version of the logo |
| `images/logo-ionity-clouds.*` | Cloud/IoT themed logo variant |
| `Ionity_Global_Pty_LTD_Transparrent.png` | Full company name logo |
| `Ionity_Global_Pty_LTD_Transparrent_optimized_1000.png` | Web-optimised (1000px) version |
| `Ai-ionity.png` | AI Ionity branded graphic |
| `ionity-logo-edited.png` | Root-level copy of primary logo |

## Using Assets in Your Project

### Direct URL (raw GitHub)

Replace `main-Ionity` with the branch or tag you need:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ionity-Global/ionity-assets-ionity-global-ionity-today/main-Ionity/<path-to-file>
```

**Example:**
```html
<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ionity-Global/ionity-assets-ionity-global-ionity-today/main-Ionity/images/ionity-logo-edited.png"
     alt="Ionity Logo" width="180">
```

### Clone the repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Ionity-Global/ionity-assets-ionity-global-ionity-today.git
```
